_comment: Gates whose failure is KNOWN, JUSTIFIED and deliberately carried past the
push guard. This is not a way to push green CI -- CI still runs every gate
and still fails on anything listed here. It only lets the push HAPPEN, with
the failure named on the record instead of routed around silently.
block-unverified-push.sh enforces three things, and the last two are what
stop this becoming a permanent allowlist:
1. every FAILING gate must appear here, or the push is still refused;
2. every gate here must actually be failing -- a stale entry REFUSES,
so an excuse cannot outlive the failure it excuses;
3. the reason must be substantive, the same bar .dead-bash-allowlist
applies and gate-test:dead-bash proves with a low-effort-BLOCKER case.
A narrowed run (--only/--skip) is refused before any of this is consulted,
so carrying cannot become a second way to launder a partial lane.

carried.reason: Needs a built packages/www/dist and this lane did not build one: the directory exists but holds ZERO .html files, so the gate refuses rather than reporting a meaningless green -- correct anti-vacuity behaviour, not a finding. In CI it runs as a STEP of job quality-www-build (manifest.ts:2342-2347), after that job's build step, so CI exercises it properly and will still fail on any real regression. Not caused by this branch: ZERO of the 29 files changed on 0827-1 are under packages/www (verified with git diff --name-only origin/0827-1..HEAD). Building www locally was deliberately not done -- a peer session is running a live GPU/TTS pipeline in this SHARED worktree and CLAUDE.md names www builds as a corruption hazard there. Clear this entry once a www build is present locally.

Same cause as check:ci-landmarks: no local packages/www build, so zero probes were comparable and the gate refuses rather than emitting a green it did not earn. Its own 6/6 self-controls PASS, so the gate logic is proven live; only its INPUT is absent. In CI it is a step of job quality-www-build (manifest.ts:2354-2359), run after the build, so coverage is not lost. ZERO of the 29 files changed on this branch are under packages/www. Not built locally because a peer session is running a live pipeline in this shared worktree. Clear this entry once a www build exists.
